line.text: The door clicks shut. From the kitchen table, Nia's ears swivel toward the sound before she looks up.
If you want some. Or ignore me. That works too.
You cooked? I thought you were coding.
Build was compiling. Needed a break. Broth keeps.
Single pot. Not a whole thing.
She pushes her fringe back with one knuckle, eyes flicking to the laptop screen, then back to you.

options.text: Thanks. I'll grab a bowl. Mind if I join you?

reaction.text: Bowl's in the cabinet. Left of the sink.
Her tail gives a single flick, then settles. She moves her laptop a few inches to make room.

options.text: You look tired. Did you sleep at all last night?

reaction.text: Her ears flatten for a second before she turns back to the screen.

options.text: Why'd you make extra? You barely eat when you're coding.

reaction.text: Broth needed using. It's not a question.
She closes the laptop with a soft click. Her tail tucks tight against the chair.

line.text: A minute passes. Steam curls off the pot. The only sound is the laptop fan winding down.
There's a bug in the water level. Collision detection. Not urgent.
She tilts the screen toward you, then stops, as if she didn't mean to.
I can fix it. Just noting it. While you eat.

options.text: I'll take a look while you eat. Two sets of eyes.

reaction.text: It's my build. I'll handle it.
She pulls the laptop back, ears flat, and stares at the screen without typing.

options.text: I don't know anything about collision. I'll just eat.

reaction.text: She turns back to the screen, but her tail sways once, loose.

options.text: Tell me what you need and I'll do it.

reaction.text: I don't need anything. It's my build.
Her shoulders pull in. The ramen sits untouched between you.

desc: You come home. Nia glances up from her laptop: she made too much ramen again, if you want some, or you can ignore her, that's fine too. First real evening as roommates.
